name: Omacom Foundation
title: Omaville
description: The omacom GitHub org drawn as a living city: who works on what, and what is being built, updated as it happens.

routine.subject: ^chore: (sync|rebuild)|^Track upstream branches|^Refresh the (data|guest package lock)|^Translate published site content|^Bump \S+ from

omarchy.what: The distribution itself: one arcology of three joined towers. Every workshop's output ends up here.

omarchy-pkgs.what: The Omarchy package repository and its build pipeline. The ram works faster the more commits landed this week.

omarchy-iso.what: The installer image. The platter turns faster the more the ISO changed this week.

omarchy-mirror.what: The Arch mirror on Cloudflare R2 that ships packages out.

omarchy-mac.what: The Mac runtime: Omarchy on M-series Macs.

apple-bcm-firmware.what: Wi-Fi and Bluetooth firmware for T2 Macs.

try-omarchy-windows.what: Omarchy in a VM on Windows.

try-omarchy.what: Omarchy in a VM on macOS.

districts.name: Apps
districts.what: Native apps and tools that ship with Omarchy, one workshop tower each.

districts.name: Themes and plugins
districts.what: Marketplaces, registries and first-party plugins, one cabinet tower each.

districts.name: Sites
districts.what: omarchy.org and the smaller sites around it.

districts.name: Upstream
districts.what: Forks and mirrors of upstream projects. Only Omacom-authored commits count.

districts.name: Archive
districts.what: Archived repositories, kept at full height as outlines.

newcomers.name: New towers
newcomers.what: Repositories without a district get their own tower on the next free lot, built up over their first two weeks.
